resources.string: Torrents cannot use a proxy; turn the proxy off to download torrents
Torrents do not use the proxy. While a proxy is on, torrents and magnet links will not download.
Accept a certificate for another host name
Less secure: the server certificate is trusted even if it was issued for a different host name
The certificate of the server does not match the host name %1$s. If you trust this server, turn on \"Accept a certificate for another host name\" in the connection.
